category: probability and stochastic processes / stochastic processes
canonical_claim: A real-valued Lévy process on nonnegative real time is a family of measurable random variables on a probability space, starts at zero almost surely, has jointly independent increments, has stationary increment laws, and is stochastically continuous. Cadlag regularity is not a definition clause and remains a separate regularization obligation.
